newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - T-BILL YIELDS MUST RISE SLIGHTLY - ZILE.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - T-BILL YIELDS MUST RISE SLIGHTLY - ZILE.

text.p: Latvian T-bill yields cannot stay at current low levels, Finance Minister Robert Zile said on Thursday.
"The current government treasury bill yields should go up, but not much...," Zile told Reuters in an interview.
Zile said that current yield levels were unsustainable.
Discount rates on Latvian T-bills have fallen sharply during the past year to reach some five percent. Yields were as high as 45 percent during the severe banking crises that hit Latvia in 1995.
Latvia's inflation fell to 13 percent in 1996 from 23 percent in 1995.
